extDescription.message: A browser assistant that reads the current page, takes files and images, and uses the page's WebMCP tools with your own model.

dock.message: Move back to the side panel

welcomeBody.message: I can read what's on this page, look at files and images you attach, and use tools the page provides. You approve page changes before they run.

promptSummarize.message: Summarize this page in a few key points.

promptCapabilities.message: What can you help me do on this page? Include any tools it provides.

connectModel.message: Connect a model to get started

tooManyImages.message: You can attach up to 4 images.

tooManyTexts.message: You can attach up to 4 text files.

imageUnreadable.message: {0} could not be read as an image.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the text to copy it manually.

statusSettingsSavedNext.message: Settings saved. Start a new session to apply them.

noticeStepLimit.message: Reached the 12-step limit. Narrow the task and continue.

noticeStopped.message: Stopped. Completed page actions have not been undone.

noticeEmpty.message: The model returned an empty response.

noticePageUnread.message: Could not read the page. Sent without page content.

noticeTooLarge.message: This conversation is too large to keep. It will reset when the panel closes.

noticeFloatFailed.message: Could not open a floating window.

toolsNone.message: This page doesn't provide WebMCP tools. You can still ask about its content.

toolsUnavailable.message: WebMCP isn't enabled in this browser. You can still ask about the page content.

toolsCantAccess.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions read this page.

modelConnectionHint.message: Connect any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.

rememberKeyHint.message: Otherwise, it stays in memory until Chrome closes.

instructionsHint.message: Set the assistant's role and response style. Changes apply to a new session.

privacyNote.message: Conversations, page content, attachments, and tool results go to your model provider. Your API key is never shared with webpages.
